# Claude Usage Limit Official Table

A clean, citable dataset of official Anthropic Claude plan usage limits with per-cell official-source citations. No fixed message counts are invented; "Not published" is preserved verbatim.

## Plans
- Free - USD 0
- Pro - USD 20/month (USD 17/mo annual effective)
- Max 5x - USD 100/month
- Max 20x - USD 200/month
- Team Standard - USD 25/seat/month (USD 20 annual)
- Team Premium - USD 125/seat/month (USD 100 annual)
- Enterprise self-serve - USD 20/seat/month annual + API usage
- Enterprise sales-assisted - USD 20/seat/month annual + API usage

## Key facts
- Anthropic publishes relative per-session usage multipliers and rolling 5-hour reset windows; it does NOT publish fixed message counts.
- Context windows: 1M / 500K / 200K tokens depending on model and surface.
- All figures sourced from official Anthropic pricing and Claude help pages.

## Sources
- S1 Claude pricing: https://claude.com/pricing
- S2 Context window sizes: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans
- S3 Pro plan: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8325606-what-is-the-pro-plan
- S4 Max plan: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11049741-what-is-the-max-plan
- S5 Team plan: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9266767-what-is-the-team-plan
- S6 Enterprise plan: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9797531-what-is-the-enterprise-plan
- S7 Enterprise billing: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11526368-how-am-i-billed-for-my-enterprise-plan
- S8 Claude Fable models: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15424964-claude-fable-models-on-your-plan
- S9 Usage and length limits: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11647753-how-do-usage-and-length-limits-work

Full machine-readable data: https://usagecaptable.com/claude-usage-limit-official-table.csv
